title: Smart Travel Assistant - AWS Serverless Architecture
intro: Event-driven corporate travel automation platform on AWS Serverless (ap-southeast-2 Sydney) featuring Vision OCR, Channel-Based RBAC, Zero-Hallucination AI Travel BI, Dual-Write Audit Sync, and 24h Flight Reminders.

nodes.label: Travelers & HR
detail: Employees upload tickets in #travel-booking; HR admins run AI Travel BI, edit saved trips, and use /travel-admin in #biz-admin-alerts.

nodes.label: Slack Platform
detail: Separates #travel-booking (EMPLOYEE) and #biz-admin-alerts (ADMIN_HR), renders Block Kit preview and BI report cards, and hosts 14-field edit modals.

nodes.label: API Gateway
detail: Terminates TLS 1.3 webhooks and routes /slack/events, /slack/commands, and /slack/interactions to Slack Handler Lambda.

nodes.label: EventBridge
detail: Triggers daily 24h departure scans at 08:00 AM VN (cron(0 1 * * ? *)) with managed retries.

nodes.label: Slack Handler
detail: Verifies HMAC-SHA256, returns sub-80ms async Fast-ACK, enforces Channel RBAC, runs Vision OCR normalization and Deterministic AI Travel BI, and commits Dual-Write records.

nodes.label: Flight Reminder
detail: Scans APPROVED flights departing within 24h, generates AI destination guides, posts alerts to #biz-admin-alerts, and syncs SENT status to DynamoDB and Google Sheets Column U.

nodes.label: DynamoDB
detail: Stores confirmed trips with SHA-256 row_hash, temporary DRAFT#channel states, atomic EVENT# deduplication locks, and serves sub-10ms BI analytics scans.

nodes.label: CloudWatch
detail: Collects Lambda execution logs, API Gateway telemetry, and error traces with 14-day retention.

nodes.label: OpenRouter AI
detail: Runs Vision OCR (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free), BI query planning and executive insight synthesis, conversational edits, and 24h travel guides.

nodes.label: Google Sheets
detail: Maintains 23 standardized itinerary columns (A to W) authenticated via RSA-SHA256 Service Account JWT, including Column U reminders and Column W audit notes.

items.text: Traveler uploads a flight ticket image in Slack. API Gateway returns HTTP 200 in under 80ms via async Lambda self-invocation, deduplicates events in DynamoDB, extracts itinerary JSON via OpenRouter NVIDIA Vision AI, normalizes IATA cities and prices, stages a DRAFT# record, and posts a Block Kit preview card.

User edits via the 14-field Slack modal or thread reply (automatically disabling buttons on superseded cards), then clicks [Xac nhan] to commit. Slack Handler dual-writes 23 columns to Google Sheets (RSA-SHA256 JWT) and Amazon DynamoDB with a SHA-256 row_hash.

Channel-Based RBAC blocks admin commands and financial prompts in #travel-booking (EMPLOYEE). In #biz-admin-alerts (ADMIN_HR), natural language BI questions run through a 3-stage Zero-Hallucination pipeline: AI Query Planner, Deterministic JS Engine over DynamoDB, and AI Executive Synthesizer.

Amazon EventBridge triggers Flight Reminder Lambda daily at 08:00 AM VN. It scans DynamoDB for APPROVED flights departing within 24h, generates an AI destination guide, posts alerts to #biz-admin-alerts, and syncs status SENT to both DynamoDB and Google Sheets Column U.
